items.source: Please note that the & and | operators may not be mixed without using parentheses. For example, "a & b | c" is not a valid expression: it must be expressed as "(a & b) | c" or "a & (b | c)".
items.translation: 请注意，如果不使用括号，不能混合使用 `&` 和 `|` 运算符。例如，`"a & b | c"` 不是有效的表达式：必须表示为 `"(a & b) | c"` 或 `"a & (b | c)"`。

items.source: Two Profiles instances returned by this method are considered equivalent to each other (in terms of equals() and hashCode() semantics) if they are created with identical profile expressions.
items.translation: 此方法返回的两个Profiles实例，如果它们使用相同的profile 表达式创建，则在equals()和hashCode()语义上被视为等价。

items.source: May be implemented directly or, more usually, created using the of(...) factory method.
items.translation: 可以直接实现，或者更常见的是使用 of(...) 工厂方法创建。

items.source: A profile expression may contain a simple profile name (for example "production") or a compound expression. A compound expression allows for more complicated profile logic to be expressed, for example "production & cloud".
items.translation: 配置文件表达式可以包含简单的配置名称（例如 `"production"`）或复合表达式。复合表达式允许表达更复杂的配置逻辑，例如 `"production & cloud"`。

items.source: The returned instance will match if any one of the given profile expressions matches.
items.translation: 返回的实例将在给定任何一条配置文件表达式匹配时匹配。

items.source: The following operators are supported in profile expressions.
items.translation: 配置文件表达式中支持以下运算符。

items.source: Create a new Profiles instance that checks for matches against the given profile expressions.
items.translation: 创建一个新的Profiles实例，该实例会检查与给定的profile 表达式是否匹配。

items.source: Test if this Profiles instance matches against the given predicate.
items.translation: 测试此Profiles实例是否匹配给定的谓词。

items.source: ! - A logical NOT of the profile name or compound expression
items.translation: ! - 配置文件名或复合表达式的逻辑 非 运算结果

items.source: & - A logical AND of the profile names or compound expressions
items.translation: & - 配置文件名或复合表达式的逻辑 AND

items.source: | - A logical OR of the profile names or compound expressions
items.translation: | - 配置文件名或复合表达式的逻辑“或”运算结果
profileExpressions - 要包含的 配置文件表达式

items.source: a new Profiles instance
items.translation: 一个新的Profiles实例

items.source: isProfileActive - a predicate that tests whether a given profile is currently active
items.translation: isProfileActive - 一个用于测试给定配置文件当前是否处于活动状态的谓词。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
